headline: TFG London cyberattack disrupts Phase Eight, Hobbs and Whistles retail systems
summary: TFG London, which owns fashion retailers Phase Eight, Hobbs and Whistles, confirmed a cybersecurity incident that disrupted its IT systems and apologized to customers. One report's headline named only Phase Eight and Hobbs as affected, while another also named Whistles. Separately, H&M is investigating an unrelated hacking claim.

claims.statement: TFG London, owner of Phase Eight and Hobbs, confirmed a cybersecurity incident and apologized to customers for the disruption.

sources.quote: Phase Eight and Hobbs owner hit by cyber-attack, as H&M probes separate hack claim
TFG London has apologised to customers for disruption after it identified a "cybersecurity incident" on Sunday.

claims.statement: The cybersecurity incident impacted IT systems used by the Phase Eight, Hobbs, and Whistles fashion brands.

sources.quote: TFG London detected a cybersecurity incident that impacted IT systems used by the Phase Eight, Hobbs, and Whistles premium fashion brands.

claims.statement: H&M is separately investigating a different hacking claim.
